subject: Community Preservation Act FY2027 Applications
overview: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed five new applications for fiscal year 2027 funding across housing, historic preservation, and open space categories. The committee also discussed a request to pivot existing funds to cover cost increases for the Condon Shell lighting project.

items.title: ABCD Medford Move In Medford Move Forward
items.summary: Joshua White presented a request for $117,043 to provide first and last month's rent assistance and long-term case management for 20 low-income households.

items.title: City Hall Facade Restoration
items.summary: Facilities Director David McIntyre requested $300,000 for limestone facade repairs and a comprehensive building conditions assessment, leading to committee discussion on the root causes of water damage and restoration versus maintenance standards.

items.title: City Hall Drinking Fountains
items.summary: The committee reviewed a $51,000 request to replace three drinking fountains with ADA-accessible units featuring bottle fillers, with suggestions to increase the budget for copper panel replacement.

items.title: Condon Shell Lighting Budget Pivot
items.summary: Recreation Director Kevin Bailey proposed pivoting $50,000 from a previously awarded Tufts Field project to cover a budget shortfall for Condon Shell lighting caused by increased material costs and necessary footing replacements.

items.title: Victory Park Athletic Courts
items.summary: The committee heard a $264,000 request to resurface the Victory Park tennis and basketball courts, including all new hoops, nets, and fencing.

items.title: Open Space Tree Plantings
items.summary: The Department of Public Works requested $75,000 to fund tree plantings in city parks to bolster the canopy and replace trees lost to infestations.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee postponed the approval of September minutes and voted to adjourn.
